title: SIDESTORY: DARKNIGHTS MEMOIR OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Darknights Memoir event stages will be open for a limited-time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, "Hit List" event missions will be available, the missions can be completed in the event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: 5* Event Operator Sideroca, Seven Cities-Style Restaurant Furniture (Pieces), Anonymous Tags.
DETAILS: Players can collect Anonymous Tags through completing Event Stages and "Hit List" event missions to redeem items from Scar Market.
MAIN REWARDS: Sideroca's Token, Seven Cities-Style Restaurant Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Furniture Part, Elite Materials, etc.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ILLUSIONS OF THE PAST
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Illusions of the Past", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Illusions of the Past", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
NOTE: New Operator Sideroca is currently ONLY available to recruit from event Darknights Memoir, is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
04 NEW FURNITURE SET – SEVEN CITIES - STYLE RESTAURANT
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Seven Cities-Style Restaurant, will be available during the event.
Darknights Memoir event rewards and redeem in Scar Market (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from December 10, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 7, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
